@aahlenst Why are agents not allowed to post issues? What's the difference between me copy/paste-ing an LLM drafted proposal and leaving out the fact that it was Claude who did the actual work with me on the loop?

I guess my question is more related to this: [https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/11668](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/11668)

Having a **succeededWithWarnings** state that will continue the CI but indicate (via an amber exclamation mark?) that further investigation is needed. Referring to your issue that allows those warnings stand out in the log then of course also helps.

I could not find anything related to that, but I could have easily missed something...
